newsitem.title: LEBANON: Volume up on Beirut Stock Exchange.
newsitem.headline: Volume up on Beirut Stock Exchange.

text.p: Solidere B and Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce rose in increased turnover on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Thursday.
There was no change in four other stocks traded and no trade in the shares of the three other listed companies.
The LIBX bank index rose 0.23 percent to 153.39. The LISPI and BLOM general indices rose 0.28 percent to 89.36 and 0.68 percent to 931.88 respectively.
Market turnover rose to 205,695 shares from Wednesday's 67,755 and value jumped to $1,876,994 from $736,020.
Solidere B rose to $10.75 from $10.5 and BLC rose to $18.25 from $18.125.
Both Solidere A and B shares were in heavy demand but the A shares were unchanged at $10.5.
Banque Audi and Bank of Beirut were unchanged at $23.125 and $3.875 respectively.
Of the four industrials, Ciments Libanais was unchanged at $1.28125 on turnover of 16,748 shares.
There was no trade in the other three industrials, Eternit, Uniceramic and Ciments Blancs.
